category_definitions.older_cross_service_transfer_plausible: No recent target count is stated; older USER ticket quantities could supply it if cross-service party continuity is assumed. This is not a demonstrated delayed proposal acceptance.
category_definitions.recent_explicit_slot_value: The current USER expresses the target count for the requested slot in words; older context is unnecessary for that count.
category_definitions.recent_value_with_mapping_ambiguity: The target count is explicitly stated within history4, but service assignment or cross-service group continuity is not explicit.

decision: This complete proxy set does not justify a source-separated proposal-memory fit. The main effect is literal digit/number-word mismatch plus incidental matches; four cases motivate, at most, a separate explicit cross-service party-transfer diagnostic with a ledger comparator.
limitations: All cases were selected by the literal-history proxy and reviewed with their targets visible.
These categories were defined during qualitative inspection; they are descriptive judgments, not a new numerical gate.
Recent semantic availability is not a measured model success or proof that the official service assignment is uniquely supported.
Older party continuity is plausible but not explicitly requested; no labels were changed.
Zero clean delayed-proposal cases in this proxy set does not establish their absence elsewhere in the cohort.
No comparison to the parent reviewer judgments or inter-rater agreement is included.
review_mode: Label-aware qualitative source inspection; not blinded and not model evaluation.
